liveAvailability._doc: Naruto Blazing game menu. Edited by hand. featured: the ninjas in the spotlight (ninja = id in ninjas.json, tag = the chip text; cutin = the ninja's game cut-in cut flat at the bottom (here the 5-star versions), framed = the cut-in is a whole scene, not a figure; without a cutin the card uses the ninja's own game art). banners: the summon banners that are up (title, image = the game's own list banner (367 x 118, scripts/naruto-blazing/extractBanners.py) in public/naruto-blazing/summons/, big = the game's big summon banner (750 x 400) shown in the banner's detail view, rareId = the gasha_rare_id of its Drop Rate page (scripts/naruto-blazing/importSummonRates.py), steps = per-level guaranteed ninjas (pool, ninja ids) and boosted rates (rateUp) the game announces but its Drop Rate page lacks, merged in by that importer; no dates: they just stay up until you take them out of this list). events: image = square thumbnail for a card; banner = a wide image (public/naruto-blazing/events/) that goes on the strip that scrolls by itself, and then the event has no card. An event is one of: permanent:true (always on), weekdays:[1,2] (a 24 h event on only those weekdays, 0 = Sunday, resetting at midnight in `timezone`: UTC, the game server's clock), or start + days:30 (or end) for a limited one. Anything whose end has passed, and any weekday event on the wrong day, is hidden by itself. Awaken = the scroll missions and Enhance = the Ramen Report cups: on BLAZING Revive every element and the All Scrolls / All Cups ones are open every day (permanent), as in scripts/naruto-blazing/importFarming.py (SERVER_DAYS). halfStamina: the game shows its "Half stamina usage!" campaign sign on the event (every event has it now); storyHalfStamina: the same campaign on the Story & Gaiden stages. launch: the server's first day (Day 1 of the roadmap). upcoming: the roadmap of the menu's Upcoming button (Live now heading), one entry per summon or mission, grouped by date into weeks: {date: "YYYY-MM-DD" (the day the week starts), kind: banner | event, title, subtitle?: the featured ninja of a Blazing Festival, fest?: true, image?: the banner picture (public/naruto-blazing/upcoming/, cut from the roadmap image), ninjas?: [ninja ids], note?}; weeks that are over hide themselves, and the end of every limited event is added to its week.
